page_title: INT 2-2 BOL | Inter v Bologna 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Sam Beukema (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

90+2' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bologna, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
90+1' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) is given a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Carlos Augusto (Inter) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.

84' Carlos Augusto (Inter) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.
83' Substitution. Hakan Calhanoglu will be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
83' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Riccardo Orsolini and he is replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
83' It will be a substitution. Tommaso Corazza (Bologna) is ready to enter the pitch as Lorenzo De Silvestri walks off.
79' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Alexis Sanchez (Inter) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
78' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
78' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Joshua Zirkzee will be replaced by Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna).
76' The substitution has been made. Davide Frattesi (Inter) has replaced Henrikh Mkhitaryan.

76' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Marco Guida with no other option than to blow for a foul. Inter will take a free kick.

73' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
73' Inter will take a corner kick.
73' An attempted cross from Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Simone Inzaghi is stunned as referee Marco Guida shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
70' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
69' Bologna fail to score from a corner as Yann Sommer (Inter) leaps to collect the ball. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
68' Remo Freuler (Bologna) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Bologna win a corner.
65' Inter quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
64' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a chance to score from a corner.
64' The corner is swung in and Francesco Acerbi (Inter) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the left post from close in.
63' The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
61' The goal by Inter is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
61' A substitution has been made. Dan Ndoye goes off and Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) comes on.
60' The Inter players joy may have been justified, because referee Marco Guida is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
59' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Alexis Sanchez (Inter) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was quite harsh and Marco Guida didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Substitution. Marcus Thuram makes way for Alexis Sanchez (Inter).
55' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Denzel Dumfries is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Inter).
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Dimarco leaves the pitch and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes on.
52' 2 - 2 Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is teed up on the edge of the box by Lewis Ferguson, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 2:2.
51' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
50' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bologna are going to take it.
49' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
46' Marcus Thuram (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
45+1' Marco Guida blows his whistle. Marcus Thuram (Inter) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Bologna.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Denzel Dumfries (Inter), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
43' A lofted cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
42' The resulting corner from Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is cleared.
42' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.
40' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Lukasz Skorupski comes off his line to gather the ball.
38' Marcus Thuram (Inter) commits a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. Bologna have a free kick.

37' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Benjamin Pavard (Inter) after he collected a pass and unleashed his low drive. The ball was directed towards the left post, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.

36' Henrikh Mkhitaryan nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Lautaro Martinez (Inter), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.

35' A big opportunity is wasted by Federico Dimarco (Inter), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Lukasz Skorupski pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
33' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Dan Ndoye (Bologna) for his blatant foul.
31' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post.
31' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Lukasz Skorupski to dive and make a save. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Marco Guida blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Inter win a free kick.
29' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) passes the ball onto Lautaro Martinez, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
27' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

23' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) connects with the ball in the six-yard box after the resulting free kick and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer makes a magnificent save! The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
21' Referee Marco Guida sees the trip by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Bologna.
19' 2 - 1 Goal! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Yann Sommer.
19' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
18' The Bologna players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
17' There's a break in play and referee Marco Guida must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bologna using VAR. This could be interesting!
17' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
17' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
14' A pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

13' 2 - 0 Nice piece of skill by Lautaro Martinez (Inter). He perfectly collected a pass from Marcus Thuram and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went inside the right post. The score is 2:0.
11' 1 - 0 The resulting corner is whipped in by Hakan Calhanoglu and Francesco Acerbi (Inter) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top left corner. The score is 1:0.
10' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
10' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.
8' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

8' Denzel Dumfries receives a sweet cross inside the box from Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Inter will take a corner.
6' A rebound falls at the feet of Lewis Ferguson (Bologna), whose promising strike from long range flies a few inches wide of the left post! What a great effort!
5' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) got on the end of the corner and rifles a low shot from the edge of the box towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a stunning diving save.
4' Inter take a short corner kick.
3' Federico Dimarco (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Inter.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bologna will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marco Guida.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
